posts.author: avp2master
posts.title: laptops/online selling system
posts.html:
Alright, do you sometimes have unwanted things such as spare knives and guns, want to sell them for cheap, but nobody wants to buy them?I was thinking of having laptops implemented in the server, so we can sell stuff "online", like an evocity ebay or amazon.


So how it would work-

1. You would turn on your laptop

2. And the evocity ebay/amazon thing would pop up in your screen.

3. On the screen, you would have two tabs labeled as "sell" and "buy"

4. clicking on the "sell" tab would load a page with the item model, item name, cost, and your own or the regular description. So you can set the price of the item, do w/e, and click "ok"

5. Then your item would go on the "buy list", and if people click on your item, they see the sell page, and click "buy" or "back"

--Buying--

1. most of it explained on the top, but you would click buy, a list of items that others want to be sold would pop up, you would click on the item, and buy it.


So this would be ALOT easier for arms dealers, cooks, medics, and other people that want to sell.


...and you would have to buy the laptop, of course [image not archived: Smiley]
